questions.prompt: Which ancient seafaring people helped spread an early alphabet around the Mediterranean?
questions.fact: Their alphabet is the ancestor of Greek, Latin and most alphabets in use today — spread by traders rather than by conquest.

questions.prompt: Which gas do many plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.fact: The oxygen is a waste product. Plants are after the carbon, and nearly all of a tree's mass comes from air rather than from soil.

questions.prompt: The pole vault is part of which sport category?
questions.fact: Vaulters clear over six metres using poles that store and return energy. The switch from bamboo to fibreglass transformed the event.

questions.prompt: What food does Winnie-the-Pooh famously love?
questions.fact: A. A. Milne wrote Pooh for his son Christopher Robin, whose toy bear was named after a real bear at London Zoo called Winnie.

questions.prompt: Which country is the most populous in Africa?
questions.fact: It has more people than any other African country, and more than 500 languages are spoken within its borders.

questions.prompt: In many spreadsheets, what symbol starts a formula?
questions.fact: It tells the spreadsheet to calculate rather than store text. Leave it off and the formula is just a string of characters.
